title: A site can see where it has drifted from current defaults
description:
A scaffolded site no longer inherits improved defaults. It needs to see what changed.

```gherkin
Feature: Scaffold diff

  Scenario: Drift is reported and nothing is changed
    Given a site scaffolded with an earlier Papyrus version
    When I run the scaffold diff
    Then I see each record that differs from the current default
    And no record is changed
```
